hook: Claude Haiku 5.5 just slashed token prices by 90% for everyday requests.

sections.voiceover: Claude Haiku 5.5 just slashed token prices by 90% for everyday requests.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of Anthropic pricing interface displaying the 90% drop.

sections.voiceover: Anthropic dropped Claude Haiku 5.5 on October 7, 2026, so how cheap is it? He also stated that the previous model charged $5 per million output tokens.
sections.visual_cue: Split screen comparison showing price change from $1 to $0.10.
b_roll: Simon Willison blog post snippet on Claude Haiku 4.5 pricing

sections.voiceover: Except this drop only applies to requests under 100,000 tokens.
sections.visual_cue: Highlighted text showing the 100,000 token request threshold.
b_roll: Anthropic documentation showing token threshold limits

sections.voiceover: Anthropic dropped input costs to $0.10 per million tokens. Carl Franzen reported the release at VentureBeat. Output costs now sit at $0.50 per million tokens to match competitor pricing.
sections.visual_cue: Terminal display showing input cost of $0.10 and output cost of $0.50.

sections.voiceover: Claude Haiku 5.5 carries a 1 million token context window.
sections.visual_cue: Full overview screen displaying the 1 million token context window.
